events.title: Pre-Warp Age. Version 1.0.22.
events.summary: GameplayThe full game now supports mods and Steam Workshop.The first free mod, “Robot Corporation”, is already available in Steam Workshop. Robots replace living employees and consume Energy instead of Water. Producing robots costs Minerals, and robots can synthesize Minerals from Water and Energy.New achievements: “Hardcore player” and “First launch”. The game now has 65 achievements.Miners have been strengthened: Workers extracting Water or Minerals produce 0.3 more units of their assigned res

events.title: Pre-Warp Age. Version 1.0.21.
events.summary: Game modesA new menu during game setup lets you choose your preferred play style:“Meditation” offers the familiar gameplay of earlier Pre-Warp Age versions, with a more casual play style.“Classic” offers turn limits and a greater challenge, closer in spirit to earlier Clarus Victoria games.“Hardcore” builds on “Classic” with actions that take multiple turns and natural population growth.GameplayAdded 64 achievements. events.title: The Pre-Warp Age demo is out now!
events.summary: The free demo of Pre-Warp Age is now available on Steam! Download it from the game’s store page. All scenarios and corporations are included in the demo.Which corporation will you choose?Miners: specialists in exploration and extracting resources from planets.Technocrats: scientists who clone their best specialists.Magnates: capitalists squeezing every last bit of profit out of space.Colonists: enthusiasts and builders of a dystopia beyond their home planet.You can play up to turn 40 in the demo
